---
title: Creating Vendors
description: Add vendors manually or by import.
---

Vendors can be created one at a time from the **New Vendor** form, or imported
in bulk.

## Create a vendor

<Steps>

<Step>
### Open the form
Go to **Vendors Management → Vendors** and select **New Vendor**.

<Screenshot src="/images/purchases/vendors/vendor-list-annotated.jpg" alt="Vendors list with New Vendor highlighted" caption="Select New Vendor (3) in the top-right corner." />
</Step>

<Step>
### Enter vendor details
Enter the **Vendor Name** and **Payment Term** (both required). You can also
enter the **Website URL**, **DBA (Doing Business As)**, **Payment Method**,
**Category**, and **Branches**.

<Screenshot src="/images/purchases/vendors/new-vendor-1.jpg" alt="New Vendor form — vendor details" caption="(1) Vendor Name, (2) Website URL, (3) DBA, (4) Payment Term, (5) Payment Method, (6) Category, (7) Branches, (8) Mailing address." />
</Step>

<Step>
### Enter the address
Under **Mailing**, complete **Address Line 1**, **Address Line 2**, **City**,
**State**, **Country**, and **Zip Code**. The **Address Type** is **Mailing**.
Select **Add More Address** to add another address.

<Screenshot src="/images/purchases/vendors/new-vendor-address.jpg" alt="Vendor mailing address" caption="(1) Mailing address fields, (2) Address Type, (3) Add More Address." />
</Step>

<Step>
### Add the primary contact
Under **Contacts → Primary Contact**, enter the **First Name**, **Email**, and
**Phone Number** (required), and optionally **Last Name**, **Mobile Number**,
and **Title**. The **Contact Type** is **Primary**. Select **Add Secondary
Contact** to add another contact.

<Screenshot src="/images/purchases/vendors/new-vendor-2.jpg" alt="Vendor primary contact" caption="(9) Primary contact fields, (10) Add Secondary Contact." />
</Step>

<Step>
### Attachments, options, and save
Optionally attach files under **Attachments**. Turn on **R2 Certified** if the
vendor is R2 certified, or **Also create as Customer** to create the vendor as a
customer too. Select **Create** to save, or **Cancel** to discard.

<Screenshot src="/images/purchases/vendors/new-vendor-3.jpg" alt="Vendor options and Create button" caption="(11) R2 Certified, (12) Also create as Customer, (13) Create." />
</Step>

</Steps>

## Import vendors

<Steps>

<Step>
### Open Import
On the Vendors page, select **Import**. The **Import Vendors** dialog opens.
</Step>

<Step>
### Download and fill in the template
Under **Step 1: Download Template**, select **Download Template**, then fill in
the Excel template with your vendor data.
</Step>

<Step>
### Upload the filled template
Under **Step 2: Upload Filled Template**, select **Select File** and choose the
completed file to preview and import it.

<Screenshot src="/images/purchases/vendors/vendor-import.jpg" alt="Import Vendors dialog" caption="(1) Download Template, (2) Select File." />
</Step>

</Steps>

## Managing vendors

| Action | Description |
| --- | --- |
| View | Open the vendor detail page. |
| Edit | Update an existing vendor. |
| Clone | Duplicate a vendor record. |
| Delete | Remove a vendor. |
| Add notes | Internal reference notes. See [Vendor Notes & Activities](/docs/purchases/vendors/notes-and-activities). |
| Record activities | Meetings and other activities. See [Vendor Notes & Activities](/docs/purchases/vendors/notes-and-activities). |
